description: This Java class defines the PersonAddress entity in the OpenMRS project, representing a person's address with numerous address-related fields, database mappings, and utility methods.

classes.name: PersonAddress
classes.description: Entity class representing a person's address with fields mapped to 'person_address' database table, supporting address details, status flags, and lifecycle methods.

methods.name: equalsContent
methods.description: Compares inner fields of this address with another PersonAddress instance to determine content equality, ignoring null/empty fields on the comparison object.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the PersonAddress object, noting that the nested Person object is shared between original and clone.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if any of the address fields are set (not blank).

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Provides ordering for PersonAddress objects based on voided status, preference, creation date, ID, and content equality.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Sets the address's endDate to current time, marking it as inactive.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Sets endDate to null, marking the address as active.
